services.desc: Fly Tandem After Learning How To Launch A Hang Glider On Our Bunny Hills! Fly solo off our training hills and take your first steps to become a hang glider pilot! No experience necessary, you will go through our first day of Ground School just like a real solo hang glider student. Over the course of five flights, you will learn how to control, launch, and land a hang glider under the guidance of our expert instructors. Following a short break for lunch, you will put your learnings to use flying tandem higher than the Empire State Building! Must be 14 years or older and under 250 lbs. Some physical fitness required.
